Published values used by the tests and vignettes

Source: R/common-reference.R
mhp_reference.Rd

Reads inst/extdata/reference.csv: one row per published number, with its source, the R call that recomputes it with this package (call), the expression that extracts the number from the result (extract, in terms of x), the printed value and the digits to compare. The same file drives the test of published values and the vignette that reproduces the published examples. Each distinct call is evaluated once.

Usage

mhp_reference(source = NULL, evaluate = FALSE, level = 1)

Arguments

source

optional regular expression; keep rows whose source matches.

evaluate

logical; evaluate the rows and add columns computed and agrees (default FALSE).

level

largest level evaluated (1 = fast rows, 2 = slow rows; default 1); rows above it get NA.

Value

A data.table with columns id, source, quantity, call, extract, value, digits, level, note (and computed, agrees).

See also

Other mhpfilter utilities: mhp_notation(), mhp_save(), mhp_theme()

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

ref <-
  mhp_reference(
      source   = NULL
    , evaluate = FALSE
    , level    = 1
    )
ref
